LETTER OF INTENT 
pursuant to § 1785 et seq. of Act No. 89/2012 Sb., the Civil Code 
  
The University of Pardubice 
Halls of Residence and Catering Service 
with its registered office at Studentská 95 
532 10 Pardubice 
represented by / acting through Mr / Mrs. ……………., Head of the Accommodation Services 
of the one part (hereinafter referred to as the "Accommodation Provider")  
 
and 
Mr / Mrs 
Name and Surname 
born on ….. 
Nationality: ….. 
of the other part (hereinafter referred to as “Student”)  
  
  
have agreed to conclude a future Accommodation Agreement (hereinafter referred to as the "Agreement") : 
   
I 
The subject of this Agreement is the Provider's obligation to conclude an accommodation agreement with 
the Student, in compliance with the conditions specified in this Agreement, pursuant to Section 2326 et seq. 
No. 89/2012 Sb., the Civil Code, as amended (hereinafter referred to as the “Accommodation Agreement”). 
The content of the Accommoda tion Agreement will be the Accommodation Provider's obligation to provide 
the student with temporary accommodation in the accommodation facility at:  
 
 
 
 
 
 
for the period  
  
and the Student's obligation to pay for accommodation and related services to the Accommodation Provider 
the amount determined by the Accommodation Price List, as well as to comply with the Accommodation 
Rules. 
 
II 
The Accommodation Provider undertakes to conclude the Accommodation Agreement with the Student 
immediately after being presented with a valid travel document and a residence permit in the Czech Republic 
(long-term visa, long -term residence permit). The Acc ommodation Provider's obligation to conclude the 
Accommodation Agreement with the Student shall lapse if the accommodated student fails to register in due 
course for studies at the University of Pardubice, Faculty of …., but no later than ……. . 
 
III 
This Agreement shall enter into force on the date of its signature by both Parties and may be amended and 
supplemented only in the form of written amendments signed by both Parties.  
 
This Agreement is executed in two counterparts, and each Party retains one of the counterparts. 
 
The Parties declare that they agree with the content of this Agreement and that this Agreement has been 
made freely and seriously, in witness whereof they attach their signatures.
